title: Reflect feature grid
description: A 4×2 grid of small features ruled by faint hairlines with no card fills: a 32px line icon, a white title and a muted line or two in each cell, with a short bright tick on the left rule beside each title. A soft violet light fades in from the top of a cell on hover. On phones the cells become one swipeable row that snaps cell by cell.
notes: any number of items; four columns from 1024px
the phone row scrolls inside itself (native scroll-snap), so the page never overflows
name: reflect-features

props.name: items
props.description: the cells, read left to right then down (eight in the original)
